message.content:
This grayscale editorial illustration, framed by a red border on the left and bottom, features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, black serif letters. Above this, white text reads "KORUPSI DI TERAS KA'BAH" and "WAWANCARA BEKAS 'SIMPANAN' PANGERAN BRUNEI." Below the masthead is the date "26 MEI-1 JUNI 2014."

The central image depicts two massive human heads facing each other in profile. The head on the left is seen from the back and side, while the right head is shown from a side-front view. Both heads are positioned as if they are under construction, surrounded by intricate networks of scaffolding. Tiny human figures are scattered across the scaffolding, on cranes, and even perched on facial features like noses and lips. 

A large horizontal text block in white, sans-serif font reads "HABIS TRANSAKSI TERBIT KOALISI" across the middle of the composition. In the lower left corner, a barcode and price details are visible. The background is a cloudy sky. The illustration combines biological forms with mechanical structures and diminutive human figures.
